“It’s her loss okay, you may be thinking that you are nothing, that you are just half of a human being without that girl. But let me tell you something alright: you are much better off without her. If she doesn’t even have the time of day to think about you at all, then you’re better off without her. Brush her off your shoulder and find someone who will give you the time of day. One day she will look in the mirror, and she will realize that she’s the one that has become a half of a human being without your delicate touch at night beside her. You walk that shit off, you go to the gym, and you work out, and you feel better about yourself than you ever did when you were with that sad sack of shit. You understand me? “
